title: Chip Industry Technical Paper Roundup: Aug. 18
gist: A roundup of seven newly-added technical papers spanning 2.5D PIM chiplet power delivery, self-supervised advanced-node layout repair, gate-all-around 2D CFET scaling at the A2 node, patterning defect prediction, 3D-IC failure analysis, chiplet/interposer co-optimization, and 4H-SiC wafer slicing.

insights.claim: Researchers at Washington State University and University of Wisconsin-Madison proposed ReVolt, a power-delivery-network-aware voltage-droop control method for 2.5D processing-in-memory (PIM) chiplet architectures.
insights.speaker: Linda Christensen
insights.so_what: Power-integrity control for PIM chiplets is a gating problem for scaling AI-memory-centric accelerators.
insights.quote: ReVolt: Power Delivery Network-Aware Voltage Droop Control for 2.5D PIM Chiplet Architectures

insights.claim: A*STAR proposed FAPlace, a method that jointly optimizes chiplet placement and interposer footprint for 2.5D systems rather than treating them separately.
insights.speaker: Linda Christensen
insights.so_what: Interposer footprint drives cost in advanced packaging, so joint optimization targets a key AI-accelerator BOM lever.
insights.quote: FAPlace: Joint Optimization of Chiplet Placement and Interposer Footprint for 2.5D Systems

themes.theme: AI/ML for EDA and design closure

insights.claim: NVIDIA and Duke University proposed SCALE, a self-supervised, constraint-aware layout generation approach for fixing local place-and-route design-rule violations (DRVs) at advanced nodes.
insights.speaker: Linda Christensen
insights.so_what: Automating advanced-node DRV fixing signals machine learning moving deeper into EDA design-closure workflows.
insights.quote: SCALE: Self-Supervised Constraint-Aware Layout GEneration for Local P&R DRV Fixing at Advanced Nodes

insights.claim: imec examined whether gate-all-around 2D CFETs are the optimal architecture for the A2 node and beyond.
insights.speaker: Linda Christensen
insights.so_what: CFET architecture choices at the A2 node shape the leading-edge logic roadmap that foundries and their equipment suppliers will build to.
insights.quote: Are Gate-All-Around 2D CFETs the Optimal Architecture for the A2 Node and Beyond?

insights.claim: National Taiwan University presented physics-based, data-driven, and hybrid frameworks for defect prediction across advanced patterning technologies from lithography to nanoimprint.
insights.speaker: Linda Christensen
insights.so_what: Defect prediction across patterning methods is central to yield economics at leading-edge nodes.
insights.quote: From Lithography to Nanoimprint: Physics-Based, Data-Driven, and Hybrid Frameworks for Defect Prediction in Advanced Patterning Technologies

insights.claim: Texas A&M University, KIMM, and UST developed self-focusing control for depth-precise wafer slicing of 4H-SiC using femtosecond laser processing.
insights.speaker: Linda Christensen
insights.so_what: Better SiC wafer slicing yield matters for power-semiconductor economics in EVs and AI data-center power delivery.
insights.quote: Self-Focusing Control for Depth-Precise Wafer Slicing of 4H-SiC in Femtosecond Laser Processing

insights.claim: Google and Delft University of Technology proposed an innovative failure-analysis hardware solution to enable system-level debug of 3D ICs.
insights.speaker: Linda Christensen
insights.so_what: System-level debug of 3D ICs is a bottleneck as vertically-stacked AI silicon proliferates.
insights.quote: Innovative FA Hardware Solution to Enable System-Level Debug of 3D ICs
